# High Elf: Cantrip Versatility (`traits:high-elf-cantrip-versatility`)
**Species:** [Elf](../species/elf.md) | **Subspecies:** [Elven Lineage: High Elf](../subspecies/elven-lineage-high-elf.md)
**Spells:** [Prestidigitation](../spells/prestidigitation.md)

You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
